Definition
[Composition (product) of paths]

↗ def:path

\group Fundamental Group

If $f(1)=g(0)$, define \[ (f\cdot g)(s)=\begin{cases} f(2s),& 0\leq s\leq \frac12,\\ g(2s-1),& \frac12\leq s\leq 1. \end{cases} \]

If $f_0\simeq f_1$ and $g_0\simeq g_1$ through compatible endpoint-fixed homotopies, then $f_0\cdot g_0\simeq f_1\cdot g_1$ by concatenating the homotopies at each parameter value.
